page: Microsoft Azure E8-2ds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine running on Microsoft Hyper-V. It is powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8573C processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture, configured with one physical core, two virtual cores, and a boost clock speed reaching up to 4.2 GHz. The CPU package features 48 KB of L1 data cache, 2 MB of L2 cache, and a large 260 MB L3 cache. It incorporates advanced vector and matrix extensions including AVX-512, AVX-VNNI, AMX-TILE, and AMX-INT8, along with hardware-accelerated cryptographic primitives like AES, VAES, and SHA-NI.

Hardware allocation emphasizes memory density over aggregate compute throughput, provisioning 64.0 GB of system RAM across only two vCPUs (32.0 GB per vCPU). In addition to system memory, the instance bundles 472 GB of local NVMe SSD storage for scratch space and temporary caching. Accelerators are not included, with GPU count sitting at zero, and complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not provided.

Benchmark results highlight strong single-threaded performance contrasted with constrained multi-core execution. The instance achieved a Geekbench single-core score of 2156.0 and single-threaded gzip compression of 31.32 GB/sec, placing it in the top 25 percent. Conversely, stress-ng multi-core CPU output scored 1991.98 and Geekbench multi-core reached 2649.0, both landing in the bottom quartile due to the two-vCPU ceiling. Large-block uncached memory read bandwidth reached 21.49 GB/sec while write bandwidth posted 14.14 GB/sec. Redis SET operations measured 2.81 million operations per second, and PassMark database operations scored 1624.75.

The constrained CPU allocation combined with high memory capacity delivers a specialized cost-efficiency profile. Workloads that do not require high core counts but require large in-memory footprints can avoid paying for unneeded vCPUs. This configuration is best suited for memory-intensive caching layers, in-memory key-value databases, lightweight ETL staging, and memory-constrained analytical tasks with bounded compute demands.
description: Microsoft Azure E8-2ds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine tailored for low-core workloads with large memory requirements. Built on the x86_64 Intel Xeon 8573C processor running at up to 4.2 GHz, the instance delivers two dedicated vCPUs from a single physical core, alongside 64.0 GB of RAM (32.0 GB per vCPU) and a 472 GB local NVMe SSD. It features advanced vector instructions including AVX-512 and AMX, and does not include integrated GPUs. In benchmarks, the server demonstrates strong single-threaded capabilities, scoring 2156.0 in Geekbench single-core, but exhibits restricted multi-core throughput and moderate uncached memory bandwidth due to its 2-vCPU configuration. This resource balance makes it an efficient platform for memory-heavy operations with modest parallel computing needs, such as Redis caching layers, small in-memory database replicas, intermediate data staging, and lightweight data pipelines.
